## 406. The free-energy principle as a case: a chooser reading what couples in, its rule read from the count of its choices (UE1)

UE, a unified explanation of reality, became one of the main objectives on 25 October 2026 ([source](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-25-unified-explanation-of-reality.md); [plan](../../development/ue-unified-explanation/PLAN.md)). Its first containment is the free-energy principle, the most developed rival unification of self-organization and cognition, and the one now offered as the basis of collective human and AI intelligence. A containment has three parts:

1. the framework's premises set on the premise card;
2. an instance or equivalence theorem in Lean;
3. something the theory forbids that the framework leaves open.

The bridge's note ([UE1](../../development/ue1-fep-bridge/NOTE.md)) states the principle in its own terms from the sources read and sets its premises on the card.

**How it stands to active inference.** The 2016 paper (Friston, FitzGerald, Rigoli, Schwartenbeck, O'Doherty and Pezzulo, §2.4) counts beliefs about the selected policy at the end of each trial, and SPM12 adds the end-of-trial posterior over policies to the habit's counts. Where the trial's outcomes reveal the policy pursued, that posterior is concentrated on it, so the count is close to the count of the executed policy, `choose`'s count; policies that explain the trial equally share it, which the kit does not model. The simulation of devaluation (§5.2) shows the persistence over the trials it runs: devalued at trial 48 the habit persists and strengthens with use, devalued after 16 trials the agent switches at once. Under any counting the decision at a change of score is the posterior's argmax, so the outcome turns on the counts against `κo/κc` at the change, where the rule is read again before the next choice. What counting the choice adds, in the model, is that under a standing score the decision never reverses.

**A restatement, its third part open.** The lock is the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989), and counting the action taken is the value-free habit (Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig 2019); active inference's own simulation already shows the persistence. The contrast with counting the posterior at the time of choosing concerns a rule no implementation cited uses, and the pooling result is the pool law read onto belief sharing under its hypotheses. So UE1 is recorded as a restatement. A real third part needs a statement in the principle's literature that the theory forbids; the first candidate is a claim that belief sharing lets a collective respond to what no member couples to. In rats, extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation (Adams 1982; Dickinson 1985); five attempts to induce this in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018).

**The review.** An independent read-only review by a separate AI agent ([REVIEW-UE1](../../development/ue1-fep-bridge/REVIEW-UE1.md)) found the Lean sound and the note not ready: 3 errors, 8 overclaims, 9 imprecisions, 3 suggestions. The errors:

- the scheme active inference uses was matched to the wrong case;
- the frozen test as first stated would have refuted a prediction the Lean does not make;
- `uniform_locks` was cited where it does not apply.

All 23 findings were taken: the module renamed (board rule 8), its statements started in sync, the rule clause and the choice below the threshold added, the stale and moved witnesses added, the posterior-counting laws derived from `RuleShaping` (rule 9), the note rewritten and the third part withdrawn. The reviewer's re-check of the revision found 22 findings fully addressed and one partly (a reading resting on an unreviewed draft, now labelled), with three small new issues, none in a proof, all fixed before landing: the pooled blindness law retitled, the frozen test's sampling clause made exact, and two wordings.

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. The blanket is the boundary of one closure among several: what feeds a pattern can lie beyond what couples into it, and the principle's single dependence structure has no separate place for that gap. Closed self-evidencing is capture through the rule; it is the meta-attractor only where the score too is formed from what it selects. Belief sharing pools couplings at most, and sharing a generative model alone pools nothing.
